build_CornerHead: build a CornerNet detection head that predicts paired top-left and bottom-right corner keypoints for object detection
create_BiCornerPool: create a bidirectional corner pooling module that pools features in top-left and bottom-right directions for corner detection
test_CornerHead_forward: test the CornerHead forward pass to produce corner heatmaps, offsets, and embeddings from backbone feature tensors
review_CornerHead_get_targets: review the CornerHead get_targets method that generates Gaussian corner heatmaps and offset targets from ground truth bounding boxes
summarize_CornerHead_predict_by_feat: summarize the CornerHead predict_by_feat method that decodes corner heatmaps into bounding box predictions using top-k and NMS
